title: New office network
situation: A company moving into a new office needs cabling, Wi-Fi, firewall and CCTV working on day one.
work: Site survey, network design, installation, testing and labelling.
receive: Network diagram, cabling schedule, configuration backups and a handover session.

title: Move to Microsoft 365
situation: Email and files are spread across old servers and personal accounts.
work: Migration plan, mail/calendar/file migration, multi-factor sign-in, licence clean-up and staff guidance.
receive: Migration plan, user and licence register and admin handover.

title: Security baseline
situation: A client asks how the business protects their data, and there is no clear answer.
work: Security assessment, multi-factor sign-in, endpoint protection, access review and a backup restore test.
receive: Written risk report, remediation record and a tested backup.
